title: Re-review v5t: its tree changed since its READY final review (round 3)
description:
Review the epic v5t again, AS INTEGRATED, before the run lands it: its final review (8rm, decision 11) judged it READY at 2b39fdb56da5, and the epic branch has changed since — now at 6ab6259b62de, with work that review never saw (a tick closed or a commit pushed after it). This is review round 3, made only because the tree changed; the run lands on YOUR verdict, not the earlier one.

Judge the tree as it stands: READY when the epic does what it said it would, NOT READY naming what blocks it.
